behavior: @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-product-telemetry-otel resolves to a Cordis service requiring otel. Endpoint, x-channel header and count limits are checked before service publication; serviceName/serviceVersion are explicit required composition values.
The adapter supplies only selected application resource identity, routing header and queue/HTTP settings. It adds no device/account/session identity and mounting alone emits no event.
Explicit compression null maps to none, matching the Source conditional; omission leaves shared exporter environment defaults in control. Actual requests ignore ambient collector credential headers.
The owning fiber drains the reporter on unload. Its deadline warns and aborts pending ordinary-event exports, including an active stalled response body.
The package manifest is copied byte-for-byte from Source (SHA-256 cc58e639b4b3a5551b6e110d00bab5edfcb61dd799f184b6f7b474da1f6ba326).
diagnostics: The first paired comparison exposed null compression being treated as omission; its mapping was corrected and the final 119 observations matched.
limitations: The service is registered; coordinated desktop/web-app bundle activation and browser product-event producers remain follow-up work. This provider commit does not claim those business flows.

Node constructor cause objects, arbitrary SDK/Agent options and the previously recorded transport adaptations are not full ABI parity claims. Full migration/release, Portable/browser and Windows 7 qualification remain pending.
